tos.basis: The core uses “overman” as a concise rendering of Übermensch; Common’s “Superman” stays on the origin.

gloss.ru: Сверхчеловек есть смысл земли.
gloss.en: The overman is the meaning of the earth.

tos.basis: The core uses “eternal recurrence” more often than “eternal return”; recurrence names Wiederkunft while Common’s wording stays on the origin.

gloss.ru: Вечное возвращение возвращает всё к этой же жизни.
gloss.en: Eternal recurrence returns all things to this same life.

tos.basis: The core uses “last man” for German “letzte Mensch”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Последний человек моргает и говорит: «Мы изобрели счастье».
gloss.en: The last man blinks and says, “We have discovered happiness.”

tos.basis: The core uses “great noon” for German “grosse Mittag”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Великий полдень приходит, когда человек стоит между животным и сверхчеловеком.
gloss.en: Great noon comes when the human being stands midway between animal and overman.

tos.basis: The core uses “will to power” for German “Wille zur Macht”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Воля к власти звучит во всём живом.
gloss.en: Will to power is the voice of every living thing.

tos.basis: The core uses “spirit of gravity” for German “Geist der Schwere”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Дух тяжести убивают смехом.
gloss.en: The spirit of gravity is slain by laughter.

tos.basis: The core uses “bestowing virtue” for German “schenkende Tugend”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Дарящая добродетель стремится дарить.
gloss.en: The bestowing virtue strives to give.

tos.basis: The Tree uses “tightrope walker” for Seiltänzer; Common’s “rope-dancer” remains on the origin.

gloss.ru: Плясун на канате идёт между башнями над площадью.
gloss.en: The tightrope walker crosses between the towers above the market.

tos.basis: The core reads the figure as a jester; Common’s “buffoon” stays on the origin.

gloss.ru: Паяц преследует плясуна на канате и сбивает его с каната.
gloss.en: The jester follows the tightrope walker and knocks him from the rope.

tos.basis: The core more often uses “creator” than “the creating one”; it directly names der Schaffende while Common’s word remains on the origin.

gloss.ru: Созидающий разбивает старые скрижали и пишет новые ценности.
gloss.en: The creator breaks the old tables and writes new values.

tos.note: Core wording uses «созидающие вместе с ним/с Заратустрой» where Antonovsky renders Mitschaffenden as «созидающих так же, как он».

forms: созидающим и празднующим вместе с Заратустрой
witness.note: Antonovsky first renders Mitschaffenden as «созидающих так же, как он»; later aligned uses include «созидающих вместе с ним» and «созидающим и празднующим вместе с Заратустрой».

tos.basis: The core’s “co-creators” keeps the shared act of creation explicit; Common’s “fellow-creators” stays on the origin.

gloss.ru: Созидающие так же, как он, пишут новые ценности на новых скрижалях.
gloss.en: Co-creators write new values on new tables.

tos.basis: The Tree uses “going under” for Untergang: it is the core’s recurring wording and keeps the source image of descending into a passage. Common’s “go down” remains on the origin.

gloss.ru: Закат Заратустры ведёт его к людям, как закат солнца.
gloss.en: Going under carries Zarathustra toward the people, as the sun goes under.

original.note: The normalized lemma is retained although it does not occur as a contiguous phrase; the source has «sich immer wieder selber überwinden» and «Selbst-Überwältigung».

tos.basis: The core uses “self-overcoming” for German “sich selber überwinden”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Жизнь должна снова и снова преодолевать самое себя.
gloss.en: Life must again and again overcome itself.

tos.basis: The core uses “higher men” for German “höhere Menschen”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Заратустра принимает высших людей в пещере как гостей и наставляет их.
gloss.en: Zarathustra welcomes the higher men as guests in his cave and teaches them.

tos.basis: The core uses “moment” for German “Augenblick”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Мгновение становится высшим, когда человек судит себя.
gloss.en: The moment becomes supreme when a human being judges himself.

tos.basis: The core uses “gateway” for German “Thorweg”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: У ворот стоит имя «Мгновение».
gloss.en: The gateway bears the name “Moment.”

original.note: The normalized lemma «Kobold» is retained; the first source use is the inflected plural «Kobolde».

tos.basis: The core uses “goblin” for German “Kobold”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Мужество создаёт себе горных духов и хочет смеяться.
gloss.en: Courage creates goblins for itself and wants to laugh.

tos.basis: The Tree chooses “backworlders” for Hinterweltler, preserving the image of people who place a world beyond this one; Common’s “backworldsmen” remains on the origin.

gloss.ru: Мечта о потустороннем мире уводит человека за пределы человека.
gloss.en: The backworlder casts his dream beyond the human being.

tos.basis: “Despisers of the body” directly renders Verächter des Leibes; Common uses the same phrase at the origin.

gloss.ru: Презирающие тело служат своему Само.
gloss.en: Despisers of the body serve their Self.

tos.basis: The core uses “tarantula” for German “Tarantel”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Тарантулы проповедуют равенство и плетут сеть.
gloss.en: The tarantulas preach equality and weave their web.

tos.basis: The core uses “pity” for Mitleid; this preserves Common’s first word and unifies the competing “compassion”.

gloss.ru: Жалость становится крестом для того, кто любит людей.
gloss.en: Pity raises its cross for the one who loves humankind.

tos.basis: The core most often uses “disgust” for Ekel; Common’s first word is “loathing”, and the alternative “nausea” gives way to the same Tree term.

gloss.ru: Великое отвращение создаёт крылья и силы, чуящие родник.
gloss.en: The great disgust creates wings and forces that sense the spring.

tos.basis: The core chooses “redemption” for Erlösung; “salvation” and “deliverance” stay on the origin.

gloss.ru: Созидание есть великое спасение от страдания.
gloss.en: Creation is the great redemption from suffering.

tos.basis: The core uses “it was” for Es war, preserving the wording of the will’s question.

gloss.ru: Заратустра называет спасением превращение «было» в «так хотел я».
gloss.en: Zarathustra calls turning “It was” into “Thus would I have it” redemption.

tos.basis: The core uses “chance” for German “Zufall”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Добро становится из зла, а цель — из случая.
gloss.en: Good grows through evil, and purpose grows out of chance.

tos.basis: The core uses “camel” for German “Kameel”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Дух становится верблюдом и несёт самое тяжёлое.
gloss.en: The spirit becomes a camel and bears the heaviest things.

tos.basis: The core uses “lion” for German “Löwe”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Лев отвоёвывает свободу для нового созидания.
gloss.en: The lion wins freedom for new creation.

tos.basis: The core uses “child” for German “Kind”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Дитя есть невинность, забвение, новое начинание и святое слово утверждения.
gloss.en: The child is innocence, forgetfulness, a new beginning and a sacred saying yes.

tos.basis: The Tree renders “Gott ist todt” directly as “God is dead.”

gloss.ru: После встречи со святым Заратустра говорит о смерти Бога.
gloss.en: After meeting the saint, Zarathustra speaks of God’s death.

tos.basis: The Tree uses “death preachers” for Prediger des Todes, naming those who preach death. Common’s “preachers of death” remains on the origin.

gloss.ru: Проповедники смерти учат, что жизнь есть страдание.
gloss.en: Death preachers make life weary and heavy.

original.note: «Fliegen des Marktes» is a chapter title; the first body use is «giftigen Fliegen».

tos.basis: The Tree chooses “flies of the market” for Nietzsche’s market figure; Common’s “poisonous flies” remains on the origin.

gloss.ru: Заратустра советует другу бежать от ядовитых мух в уединение.
gloss.en: Zarathustra urges his friend to flee the poisonous flies into solitude.

tos.basis: The Tree renders “Fernsten-Liebe” directly as “love of the furthest,” preserving the book’s chosen distance.

gloss.ru: Любовь к дальнему простирается за пределы любви к ближнему.
gloss.en: The love of the furthest reaches beyond neighbour-love.

tos.basis: The core uses “saying yes” for German “Ja-sagen”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Дитя есть первое движение и святое слово «да».
gloss.en: The child is a first movement and a sacred saying yes.

tos.basis: The core uses “life” for German “Leben”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Заратустра осуждает презрение к жизни и называет тело великим разумом.
gloss.en: Zarathustra condemns contempt for life and calls the body a great reason.

tos.basis: The core uses “spirit” for German “Geist”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Дух становится верблюдом, львом и ребёнком.
gloss.en: The spirit becomes camel, lion and child.

tos.basis: The core uses “Self” for German “Selbst”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Само слышит, ищет, сравнивает, побеждает и создаёт.
gloss.en: The Self listens, seeks, compares, conquers and creates.

tos.basis: The core uses “virtue” for German “Tugend”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Добродетель становится отвратительной в час великого презрения.
gloss.en: Virtue becomes loathsome in the hour of great contempt.

tos.basis: The core uses “wisdom” for German “Weisheit”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Мудрость Заратустры устаёт и хочет дарить.
gloss.en: Zarathustra’s wisdom grows weary and longs to give.

tos.basis: The core uses “creating” for German “Schaffen”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Созидание освобождает от страдания.
gloss.en: Creation redeems from suffering.

tos.basis: The core uses “values” for German “Werthe”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Созидающий пишет новые ценности на новых скрижалях.
gloss.en: The creator writes new values on new tables.

tos.basis: The core uses “contempt” for German “Verachtung”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Час великого презрения становится часом превращения.
gloss.en: The hour of great contempt becomes an hour of transformation.

tos.basis: The core uses “will” for German “Wille”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Воля велит сверхчеловеку стать смыслом земли.
gloss.en: The will commands the overman to be the meaning of the earth.

tos.basis: The core uses “earth” for German “Erde”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Сверхчеловек есть смысл земли.
gloss.en: The overman is the meaning of the earth.

tos.basis: The core uses “God” for German “Gott”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: После смерти бога земля открывается новому смыслу.
gloss.en: After God’s death the earth opens to a new meaning.

witness.note: Antonovsky omits the cited IV.06 passage; the listed forms come from later aligned uses of Papst, beginning in IV.11.

tos.basis: The core uses “last pope” for German “Papst”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Последний папа несёт старую веру к её концу.
gloss.en: The last pope carries the old faith to its end.

tos.basis: The core uses “soothsayer” for German “Wahrsager”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Прорицатель возвещает опустошение всего.
gloss.en: The soothsayer announces that all is empty.

tos.basis: The core uses “ugliest man” for German “hässlichste Mensch”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Безобразнейший человек скрывается от взгляда, который видит его.
gloss.en: The ugliest man hides from the gaze that sees him.

tos.basis: The core uses “voluntary beggar” for German “freiwillige Bettler”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Добровольный нищий оставляет богатство и просит милостыню.
gloss.en: The voluntary beggar leaves wealth and asks for alms.

tos.basis: The core uses “shadow” for German “Schatten”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Тень следует за Заратустрой и ищет свой путь.
gloss.en: The shadow follows Zarathustra and seeks its own way.

tos.basis: The core uses “shepherd” for German “Hirt”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Пастух кусает чёрную змею и встаёт преображённым.
gloss.en: The shepherd bites the black serpent and rises transfigured.

tos.basis: The core uses “ass” for German “Esel”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Осёл сопровождает двух королей, а позже кричит «ИА» в пещере.
gloss.en: The ass accompanies the two kings and later brays “I-A” in the cave.

tos.basis: The core uses “fire-dog” for German “Feuerhund”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Огненный пёс говорит из чрева земли.
gloss.en: The fire-dog speaks from the belly of the earth.

tos.basis: The core uses “magician” for German “Zauberer”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Чародей даёт голос тоске и скорби.
gloss.en: The magician gives voice to longing and sorrow.

tos.basis: The core uses “pale criminal” for German “bleiche Verbrecher”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Бледный преступник страдает от своего дела и видит его знак.
gloss.en: The pale criminal suffers from his deed and sees its mark.

tos.basis: The core uses “hunchback” for German “Bucklichter”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Горбатый просит Заратустру убедить калек на мосту, что тот может их исцелить.
gloss.en: The hunchback asks Zarathustra to convince the cripples on the bridge that he can heal them.

tos.basis: The core uses “king” for German “König”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Два короля оставляют свои царства и ищут высшего человека.
gloss.en: The two kings leave their kingdoms and seek the higher man.

tos.basis: The core uses “youth” for German “Jüngling”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Юноша горит тоской по высоте и свободе.
gloss.en: The youth burns with longing for height and freedom.

tos.basis: The core uses “animal” for German “Thier”; this keeps that established English reading.

gloss.ru: Орёл и змей сопровождают Заратустру.
gloss.en: Zarathustra is accompanied by his eagle and serpent.

tos.basis: The core uses “fate” for German “Schicksal”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Судьба становится тем, чего хочет воля.
gloss.en: Fate becomes what the will wills.

tos.basis: The core uses “circle” for German “Kreis”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Круг замыкает путь возвращения.
gloss.en: The circle closes the path of return.

witness.note: At the first place (I.17), Antonovsky renders the motion with «свертывается» and gives no separate noun for Ring; later aligned uses include «кольцо», «кольца» and «кольцу».

tos.basis: The core uses “ring” for German “Ring”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Кольца связывают вещи в одном возвращении.
gloss.en: The rings bind things in one return.

tos.basis: The core uses “wheel” for German “Rad”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Колесо катится из себя самого.
gloss.en: The wheel rolls from itself.

tos.basis: The core uses “courage” for German “Muth”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Мужество прогоняет призраков и хочет смеяться.
gloss.en: Courage scares away ghosts and wants to laugh.

original.note: I.01 «Tänzer» is a related person noun, not an occurrence of Tanz. The first noun use is II.10 «Tanze»; the cited translations read «танец» and “dancing”.

tos.basis: The core uses “dance” for German “Tanz”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Жизнь есть танец и игра.
gloss.en: Life is dance and play.

tos.basis: The core uses “laughter” for German “Lachen”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Смех убивает дух тяжести.
gloss.en: Laughter kills the spirit of gravity.

tos.basis: The core uses “memory” for German “Gedächtniss”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Память хранит то, что жизнь вновь переживает.
gloss.en: Memory keeps what life lives again.

tos.basis: The core uses “becoming” for German “Werden”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Мир сворачивается как становление добра через зло и становление цели из случая.
gloss.en: The world rolls together as becoming: good through evil, purpose out of chance.

tos.basis: The core uses “bite” for German “Biss”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Укус разрывает оцепенение и возвращает пастуха к жизни.
gloss.en: The bite breaks the spell and returns the shepherd to life.

tos.basis: The core uses “necessity” for German “Nothwendigkeit”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Необходимость принадлежит ходу вещей.
gloss.en: Necessity belongs to the course of things.

tos.basis: The core uses “conscientious” for German “Gewissenhafte”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Совестливый духом исследует пиявку.
gloss.en: The conscientious one investigates the leech.

tos.basis: The core uses “daughters of the desert” for German “Töchtern der Wüste”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Дочери пустыни поют о танце и любви.
gloss.en: The daughters of the desert sing of dance and love.

tos.basis: The core uses “disciples” for German “Jünger”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Ученики учатся дарящей добродетели.
gloss.en: The disciples learn the bestowing virtue.

tos.basis: The Tree names Zarathustra’s ape as a “fool”; Common’s “foaming fool” is shown at the origin.

gloss.ru: Шут предостерегает Заратустру от города и презирает его жителей.
gloss.en: The fool warns Zarathustra away from the town and scorns its people.

tos.basis: The core uses “old woman” for German “alte Weiblein”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Старушка задаёт вопрос о женщине.
gloss.en: The old woman asks a question about woman.

tos.basis: The core uses “people” for German “Volk”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Народ говорит своим языком добра и зла.
gloss.en: A people speaks its own language of good and evil.

tos.basis: The core uses “sailors” for German “Schiffsleute”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Моряки рассказывают о встреченном ими человеке.
gloss.en: The sailors tell of the man they met.

tos.basis: The core uses “saint” for German “Heilige”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Святой старец живёт один в лесу.
gloss.en: The old saint lives alone in the forest.

tos.basis: The core uses “Zarathustra” for German “Zarathustra”, preserving its word in the book.

gloss.ru: Заратустра покидает гору и идёт к людям.
gloss.en: Zarathustra leaves the mountain and goes to the people.
